parsed.main_gap: The essential large-prime erasure lemma is asserted without proof; all subsequent periodicity depends on it.

errors.description: This lemma is the core of the problem, not a routine induction. The write-up gives neither an induction hypothesis nor the claimed construction using Rp^k, so the equivalence (3) and hence periodicity remain unjustified.
errors.quote:
**Lemma.** For every sequence term \(x\), the set \(\sigma(x)\) is good.

**Proof.** Induction over the sequence terms in increasing order (standard; details omitted). \(\square\)

parsed.notes: The scan characterization (1) and the deduction of the desired identity from finite-prime periodicity are correct and substantial, but the missing lemma contains the main difficulty.
